description:
This prospectus is being issued to solicit applications for a concession campground special use permit. One permit to provide high-quality public service in the operation and maintenance of Government-owned recreation facilities located on the Monterey, Santa Lucia, Santa Barbara, Mount Pinos and Ojai Ranger Districts of the Los Padres National Forest.

The three-year average gross revenue for this opportunity is $3,292,716.00 (2021-2023).

See attached document for additional information.
